title: Soliton-like solutions of the Camassa--Holm equation with variable coefficients and a small dispersion
summary: The paper deals with the Camassa--Holm equation with variable coefficients (vcCH equation) that is a direct generalization of the well known Camassa--Holm equation. We focus on the mathematical description of particular solutions of the vcCH equation with a small dispersion that exhibit properties analogous to those of classical soliton and peakon solutions, and consider the construction of soliton- and peakon-like solutions in the form of asymptotic expansions, including both one-phase and two-phase cases.
